title: Check row
description: One row of the checks as returned by buildCheckRows(): what a check observed and its pass, warn, fail or not-available status. summary is the only row text shown outside the details; it never names a raw API. result (the raw observed value) and finding (the server message) appear only inside each row's expanded details on the result page.

summary.description: Plain-language result in sentence case, never a raw API name or value ("WebDriver detected", "WebDriver not detected", "1 of 10 extensions visible", "IP reputation lookup is off"). Shown in two places on the result page: as the second line of the row, under the check name and its status word, in the Checks performed list (#checksGroups); and on the verdict card (#verdictGroups), where buildVerdictGroupLines() quotes the summary of each failed or warned row in its group line ("Automation flags: WebDriver detected"; with more than one, "2 flags: WebDriver detected, headless browser detected"), or for the Behavior group with nothing flagged, the first judged row's summary. Not shown on the per-check pages under /checks/.
